records.scheme_name: Tamil Nadu Kalaignar Magalir Urimai Thittam (KMUT)
records.overview: Monthly direct benefit to eligible women household heads under the state income-support programme.
records.eligibility: Eligible women household heads meeting the scheme's household, income, asset and other conditions as notified by the Government of Tamil Nadu.
records.benefits: ₹1,000 per month by DBT for eligible beneficiaries, subject to current government rules.

apply.instructions: Apply through the notified KMUT/e-Sevai channels when applications are open.

faq.question: What is the Tamil Nadu Kalaignar Magalir Urimai Thittam (KMUT)?
faq.answer: Monthly direct benefit to eligible women household heads under the state income-support programme.

faq.question: Who is eligible?
faq.answer: Eligible women household heads meeting the scheme's household, income, asset and other conditions as notified by the Government of Tamil Nadu.

faq.question: What are the benefits?
faq.answer: ₹1,000 per month by DBT for eligible beneficiaries, subject to current government rules.

faq.question: What documents are required?
faq.answer: Aadhaar; ration/family card; bank account details; mobile number; income/asset details as required.

faq.question: How do I apply?
faq.answer: Apply through the notified KMUT/e-Sevai channels when applications are open.

source.verification_note: Tamil Nadu Government welfare scheme; eligibility and payment rules are subject to current notifications.
